title: 第13章 开始桩功第14章 他的计谋
slug: 夫人她只想修仙第370章自爆
content_zh:
“尝一尝？”
颜桐见颜筝感兴趣，将油纸拆开，那双一向波澜不惊的眼眸深处藏着几分期待。
颜筝也不好意思让自己姐姐失望，掰下来一块，扔进嘴里。
能进颜桐的眼，这份糕点自然美味至极，比颜筝尝过的绝大部分糕点都别有滋味。
颜筝稍微品了品，咬碎了一份花生碎。
等一下，花生碎？
颜筝一下子就愣住了，虽然原著更大侧重点放在了男女主那恶心人的爱情上，可不得不承认，在某些人物的小细节上，原著处理的还算不错。
比如颜筝身为读者就知道，女主“颜筝”
，对花生碎过敏。
颜筝本人倒是没有，自然也不会在意这些小问题。
可颜桐身为“颜筝”
的姐姐，不可能不知道自己妹妹对什么过敏。
要知道，无论什么时候，过敏——尤其是对花生过敏——很有可能造成无法挽回的后果。
在原著中，女主就因为男主的疏忽以及不知道从哪来的，莫名其妙对她嫉妒的姑娘，不小心误食了一份带有花生碎的菜肴，在原著中可是掀起了一副兵荒马乱，看的颜筝某一瞬间以为女主会就此丧命。
颜桐身为“颜筝”
的姐姐，不可能对此一无所知。
但是现在，颜桐明知道这份糕点里有花生脆，现在也只是笑着看向自己的妹妹，问：“怎么样？”
“好吃。”
颜筝艰难的点了点头，这奇怪的发展超乎她的脑容量，她不可能同时去想两件奇怪的事。
而无论怎么看，颜筝现在最重要的任务都是成为一名修士！

为此，颜筝不介意拿出对付高考的经历来对付那一些生理知识。
所谓的骨骼结构，内脏承受压力，以及有关于灵力的介绍，颜筝都一清二楚，第二天一大早，她带着那几本书，信心满满的上了青山峰。
“来吧！
我已经将这几本知识都融会贯通，随便考，随便问！”
颜筝拍了拍自己的胸脯，一脸自信。
颜桐默默收了那几本书，看了看她的表情，随即缓缓起身：“很好。
跟我来后山。”
“等一下，你不提问了？”
“就像私塾里的老师一样，说让你回去好好背，明天提问，那他有80%的概率，第二天根本不会提问。”
颜桐淡淡说道，“我以为你早就习惯了。”
只是没想到修真界里也会有这么不要脸的事发生。
颜筝不动声色的翻了个白眼，追在颜桐身后，一起来了后山。
后山一向是每个山峰灵力最浓密的地方，这就意味着那里储存了大量的资源，是外门弟子的绝对禁地，不管哪个山峰的后山都是如此。
青山峰的后山另有不同，掌门没空管的亲传弟子都会被丢到这里来历练。
颜筝跟着颜桐的脚步，小心翼翼的拨开横亘面前的枯枝，眼前豁然开朗，水天一色，只有清泉！
“我们到了。”
颜桐轻声说道，“往后一段时日里，你都会在日月潭修炼。”
“在水里吗？怎么修炼？”
颜筝好奇问道。
content_en:
"Taste it?"
Yan Tong saw Yan Zheng's interest and opened the oil paper. There was a bit of anticipation hidden deep in his usually calm eyes.
Yan Zheng was too embarrassed to disappoint her sister, so she broke off a piece and threw it into her mouth.
If it can penetrate Yan Tong's eyes, this pastry is naturally extremely delicious, and has a different taste than most pastries Yan Zheng has tasted.
Yan Zheng tasted the food for a while and bit into pieces of crushed peanuts.
Wait, crushed peanuts?
Yan Zheng was stunned for a moment. Although the original work focused more on the disgusting love between the male and female protagonists, I have to admit that the original work handled the small details of some characters quite well.
For example, as a reader, Yan Zheng knows that the heroine "Yan Zheng"
, allergic to peanut chips.
Yan Zheng himself didn't, so naturally he wouldn't care about these minor problems.
But Yan Tong is "Yan Zheng"
It’s impossible for my sister not to know what her sister is allergic to.
Be aware that any time you develop an allergy—especially a peanut allergy—there is a high chance that it will have irreparable consequences.
In the original work, the heroine accidentally ate a dish with crushed peanuts because of the hero's negligence and the girl who was jealous of her out of nowhere. In the original work, it set off a chaos of war. For a moment, Yan Zheng thought that the heroine would die.
Yan Tong is "Yan Zheng"
It is impossible for my sister to know nothing about this.
But now, Yan Tong knew that there was peanut brittle in this pastry, so he just looked at his sister with a smile and asked, "How is it?"
“Delicious.”
Yan Zheng nodded with difficulty. This strange development was beyond her brain capacity. It was impossible for her to think about two strange things at the same time.
No matter how you look at it, Yan Zheng's most important task now is to become a monk!
For this reason, Yan Zheng doesn't mind using her experience in dealing with the college entrance examination to deal with some physiological knowledge.
Yan Zheng knew everything about the so-called skeletal structure, the pressure on internal organs, and the introduction to spiritual power. Early the next morning, she took those few books with her and climbed up to Qingshan Mountain with confidence.
"Come on!
I have mastered all the knowledge in these books, so I can take any test or ask any questions! "
Yan Zheng patted her chest, looking confident.
Yan Tong silently collected the books, looked at her expression, and then stood up slowly: "Very good.
Follow me to the back mountain. "
"Wait a minute, you don't want to ask any more questions?"
"It's like a teacher in a private school who tells you to go back and memorize it carefully and ask questions tomorrow. There is an 80% chance that he won't ask questions at all the next day."
Yan Tong said calmly, "I thought you were used to it."
I just didn’t expect such shameless things to happen in the world of cultivation.
Yan Zheng rolled her eyes calmly and chased after Yan Tong to the back mountain together.
The back mountain has always been the place with the densest spiritual power of every mountain peak, which means that a large amount of resources are stored there, and it is an absolutely forbidden area for outer disciples. This is true for the back mountain of any mountain.
There is another difference in the back mountain of Qingfeng Mountain. The direct disciples that the master has no time to take care of will be thrown here for training.
Yan Zheng followed Yan Tong's footsteps and carefully pushed aside the dead branches in front of her. Suddenly, her eyes suddenly opened up. The water and sky were the same color, with only clear springs!
"We're here."
Yan Tong said softly, "You will be practicing at Sun Moon Lake for a while."
"In the water? How to practice?"
Yan Zheng asked curiously.
